recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-41426 unless the work group later decides that the Observation core-profile table should duplicate the full Vital Signs applicability rule despite the current linked guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-41426 was an Applied OO R6 change request, resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked for clearer guidance on when the Observation Vital Signs profile family applies, including renaming the main page from "Observation Vital Signs Panel Profile" to "Observation Vital Signs Profiles" and clarifying that conformance applies when the patient is known and the data is recognized and processed/displayed as a vital sign.
initial_application: The page/profile naming portion was preapplied through the FHIR-46418 vital signs rework, which set the active vital signs ImplementationGuide title to "Observation Vital Signs Profiles" and renamed the base profile to "Vital Signs Base Profile." The substantive applicability wording was then applied by commit 6cb98831954b3c61ed330358aaf541a79d0334d0, which expanded the vital signs introduction paragraphs and explicitly included the FHIR-50194 de-identified-data update.
additional_context: Observation is an active current-build resource and the vitalsigns IG is a core current-build IG. Current source states that support for observations listed in the Vital Signs table requires conformance to the Vital Signs Base and specific profiles, explains that the relevant Observation.code value sets define the expected code scope including semantically equivalent non-value-set code systems, and states that de-identified data or device measurements not yet associated with a patient are not required to conform. Jira comments in April 2025 record that adding the same detailed explanation to the Observation resource core-profile row was considered unnecessary, and the requester accepted that adding the detailed text on the Vital Signs page was enough. The tightly related FHIR-50194 clarification is already represented on the combined branch by commit 6d3f42300e6920986443661ac7cc1141796a17db.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The audit commit records that the current authoritative Vital Signs introduction already satisfies the issue and that duplicating the detailed conformance rule in the Observation core-profile summary row would be unnecessary maintenance drift.
